dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: Hmm... The sights are lovely around here. Take it all in slowly if you're interested...

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: I have to think of a way to find some young people who will seriously learn the craft of masonry...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are?

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: Hmm? Why, aren't you an intelligent-looking youngster?

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: I'm Shushan. The trustiest stonemasons of Chenyu Vale have come from my family for generations now, ever since the time of my ancestors.

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: Many of the local stone buildings were built by my family.

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: Even after retiring, I still haven't found an apprentice worthy of inheriting my skills...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Craftsmanship?

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: The craftsmanship of cutting and transporting stones, the techniques required to carve on stone surfaces... These are only some of the many things a stonemason needs to learn to perfect their craft.

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: There's not only jade to be found around here. All manner of high-quality stone lie in this vale, the best materials for building roads and houses.

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: I'm not the only stonemason around these parts, but I'm sure everyone would want their family craft, passed down from generation to generation, to continue shining brightly.

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: Am I wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Young people, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: You need skill and stamina to work with stone. Your body won't be able to cope unless you start training from a young age.

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: But some youngsters are too eager for success and end up taking the wrong path...

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: After learning some fancy skills from elsewhere, they carve and polish pure white stones to make mementos, which they then sell to outsiders...

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: Such things are nice to keep as a souvenir if reasonably priced, but they're not worth it at all if they're too expensive.

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: After all, ordinary stone is not the equal of jade. It should be used to build ordinary houses, roads, and bridges.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Shushan
dialogues.text: Take care.
